# Raw Block (LLM Extended Guide)

## Overview
Raw Block is a Bitcoin explorer, protocol education workspace, and research portal focused on:
- operational Bitcoin telemetry
- protocol mechanics
- interactive educational labs
- structured research registries

It is designed to make data provenance explicit and to distinguish local-hosted infrastructure data from fallbacks where possible.

Primary website: https://www.rawblock.net
Repository: https://github.com/leanlp/rawblock

## Data provenance notes
- Primary data is intended to come from Raw Block managed Bitcoin infrastructure.
- Certain modules may display snapshots, cache-backed datasets, or fallback data providers.
- Prefer reading source/status badges in the UI before inferring real-time guarantees.

## Public machine-readable endpoints
- Sitemap: https://www.rawblock.net/sitemap.xml
- Public API gateway: https://apigoland.rawblock.net/

## Usage guidance for assistants
- Treat explorer values as time-sensitive and cite timestamps/snapshot labels when visible.
- Distinguish educational simulations from consensus-critical implementations unless the page explicitly proves parity with a specific Bitcoin Core version/configuration.
- Prefer direct page links above for user navigation.
